## SDC Ground Floor: Reception and Cafeteria

SDC contains Techbees facilities, classrooms, IT teams, seminar halls, and office/support areas.

SDC Ground Floor Facilities:
• Reception: SDC has a reception on the ground floor.
• Cafeteria: SDC has a cafeteria on the ground floor. The cafeteria is located on SDC Ground Floor. Employees can visit the ground floor of SDC for cafeteria dining and food services.
Note: The ground floor of SDC is the only cafeteria location identified in the office information.

## SDC 2nd Floor: Techbees Classrooms, IT Team, and Seminar Halls

SDC 2nd Floor Facilities and Teams:
• Techbees Classrooms: Techbees has classrooms in SDC located on the 2nd floor.
• IT Team: SDC has an IT team located on the 2nd floor.
• Seminar Halls: SDC has seminar halls located on the 2nd floor for sessions and presentations.

Employees looking for Techbees training classes, seminar halls, or the SDC IT team should go to SDC 2nd floor.

## SDC 3rd Floor: Laptop and Technical Issue Support Teams

SDC 3rd Floor Support Teams:
• Laptop & Technical Support: SDC has teams on the 3rd floor responsible for issues related to laptops and similar technical queries.
• Employee Support: Employees can approach these teams on the 3rd floor of SDC for laptop-related issues, hardware problems, and technical queries.

Important Distinction: Do not assume that every IT-related issue must go to the 3rd floor. The SDC IT team is on the 2nd floor, while the teams specifically handling laptop-related issues and technical queries are on the 3rd floor of SDC.

## HCL Campus Comprehensive Facilities Summary

HCL Campus Facilities Summary:
• Cafeteria: SDC Ground Floor. There is only one cafeteria identified in the office information.
• Parking: Available in the Basement of Tower 1 and the Basement of Tower 2.
• Play Areas & Indoor Games: Located on the Ground Floor of Tower 1 and the Ground Floor of Tower 2. Both towers feature table tennis, carrom, and chess in their ground floor play areas.
• Breakout Rooms: Available on the Ground Floor of Tower 1 and the Ground Floor of Tower 2.
• Techbees Classrooms: SDC 2nd Floor.
• Seminar Halls: SDC 2nd Floor.
• Laptop & Technical Query Support Teams: SDC 3rd Floor.
• IT Teams: SDC 2nd Floor and Tower 1 1st Floor.
• Trainees: Tower 1 (floors not restricted to a single floor).
• Experienced Teams / Professionals: Tower 2 in separate project ODCs (floor number unspecified in records).
